positionDefinition: 官方資料 numbers 陣列為升冪排序；position 1-5 指排序位置，不代表實際搖出先後順序。
lagDefinition: lag 1 指下一個開獎期，不保證是下一個日曆日；lag 2-5 依序為後續第 2-5 個開獎期。

validation.method: First 70% of draws used to rank each trigger's five drag numbers; final 30% held out chronologically. Evaluate only test-period trigger events. No test outcomes used to choose picks.
